'''Fallon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] teenager who lived in [[Gadrin]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the leader of [[Borus's Boys]], a street gang that hung around near [[Gadrin Dump]], but he was also friends with the [[Swoop gang/Legends|speeder bike gang]], the [[SkyHawks]]. On one occasion while he was walking down a street in Gadrin, a group of [[Thaereian military]] troopers from [[Task Force Vermin]] jumped out of a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] and tried to capture him. Fallon ran for his life and he was able to evade the Thaereians with the help of the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
